senses.gloss: rodantaka, adj. (-ka extension of a-extension of pple. of rud-), weeping: LV 〔221.18〕 (vs) rodantako durmanā.

? rodita (nt.), lamentation, acc. to Senartʼs much emended text in Mv 〔i.68.8〕 (vs); the form roditehi is well supported, but perh. originally stood for roditāhi, adj. with following pramadāhi of mss. (for which Senart em. mathitā hi-, very violently). The orig. from of the passage defies reconstruction.
roditavyaka, adj. (= Skt. gdve. ˚vya plus -ka, prob. m.c.), to be wept over: te na … ˚vyakāḥ LV 〔237.11〕 (vs); na sa ˚vyakaḥ id. 12 (vs).
